audience: product and engineering teams that send notifications with Knock workflows

useCases.title: Check whether a workflow ran for a user
useCases.text: List the workflow runs for one recipient, filtered by workflow key or status. Open one run to see each step it ran.

useCases.title: Find out why an email did not arrive
useCases.text: List the messages sent to one user. Get a message, then read its delivery logs to see the provider responses.

useCases.title: Read the content a user received
useCases.text: Get one message with its channel, status and engagement times. Then get its rendered subject and body.

useCases.title: Look up users and tenants
useCases.text: List the users of the environment to find a user id. Get a tenant, such as a customer account, with its settings.

useCases.title: Trigger a workflow and cancel queued runs
useCases.text: Trigger a workflow for recipients. It sends real notifications, so check the recipients first. Cancel queued runs that match the cancellation key.
